results.title: Anwar can still focus on reforms to boost support, says KJ
results.description: Former Umno Youth chief says Anwar Ibrahim has two choices: carry out the promised reforms or leverage his authority as prime minister to consolidate his political standing.

results.title: Rahul Gandhi’s ‘Hug’ Dig at Modi Sparks BJP Anger, Meloni Reference Fuels Controversy
results.description: Rahul Gandhi: Rahul Gandhi’s “hug” remark targeting Prime Minister Narendra Modi sparked a political controversy after Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni was referenced during the exchange. The BJP strongly criticised Gandhi’s comments, calling them inappropriate and demanding an apology. results.title: CJI Surya Kant Responds to NALSAR Row: It Is Between Me and Students, Who Is BCI to Interfere?
results.description: CJI Surya Kant reacts to the NALSAR controversy, saying the matter is a dialogue between him and students and questioning BCI’s intervention. The row began after objections over his convocation invitation.
